catalog_quirks.body: NVIDIA NIM replaced its depleting trial credits with a recurring per-account rate limit (40 RPM default, varies by model), verified June 2026. The trial ToS still scopes usage to evaluation/prototyping, not production.

catalog_quirks.body: Over the 14 days to September 17, 2026 this route answered 1 of 15 attempts (Kimi K3) and 1 of 10 (DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731) on a valid key. The rest hung for 40 to 180 seconds until timeout, and direct calls hung past 240 seconds. The rows are disabled so auto routing stops spending its failover budget on them.
